items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: So I went to work for Lou Henry at the Savoy for three months.

ctx.x: All the musicians and everything else. He said, "If you go work in there, then somebody will see you. You have a better chance in New York than you have in Brooklyn."

That sounded pretty good to me. So I gave my notice then to Brooklyn, and I told Lou Henry I'd accept the job at the Savoy. So I went to work for Lou Henry at the Savoy for three months. And believe me, my stock went up just like that. Boy, people thought I was something. You'd have thought my name was in the lights down there. So...
Do you remember who else was in that band?
